title: Environment Conditions, Externalities, Habitability & Reactive-World Integration
objective: Implement owner-condition profile adapters for environmental conditions and built-environment externalities, habitability/shelter/sealing/life-support/resilience capability evaluation, owner-response routing without MBES adjudicating World truth, generic reactive-world proof including Oara sentience, and permission-safe accessible preview/explanation without creating Environment, World, consequence, habitability or response ledgers.
acceptance: Gravity, atmosphere, climate, radiation, toxicity, corrosion, ecology, magic/technology and custom conditions remain owner-profile facts rather than MBES inventions.
Construction/operation externalities such as pollution, waste, heat, noise, habitat change, resource depletion, density and land conversion emit explicit owner-facing observations only.
Accumulation, recovery and thresholds exist only where accepted owner profiles define them.
Habitability, shelter, sealing, life-support and resilience capabilities derive from explicit accepted components/networks/environment prerequisites.
World/Environment owner responses are routed without MBES deciding canonical World truth.
Oara sentience uses the same generic reactive-world interface as other living/spiritual/machine/divine worlds.
Permission-safe preview/explanation remains semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable and provider-off.
boundaries: World, Environment and Reality/Branch owners retain canonical condition and response truth.
MERA/MRCS/MIB-14 retain engineering/component/facility capability definitions where applicable.
Action/Event/GPR and target owners retain consequence/response execution authority.
MSWI remains the later unrelated-domain systemic fan-out layer.
MBES-14 creates no Environment, World, consequence, habitability, response or provenance ledger.
MBES-18 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-14 closeout.
